entry.name: Chrome for Testing
entry.verified: none published for Chrome for Testing (no checksums/signatures); fetched over HTTPS from storage.googleapis.com only; shared libs in ~/ibbrowsers/sysroot: Rocky 8 (dnf download --resolve) .rpms fetched from the distro repos, rpm -K OK on every package (distro GPG key in the system rpmdb), unpacked with rpm2cpio|cpio
entry.notes: driver is a wrapper that sources ~/ibbrowsers/env.sh (LD_LIBRARY_PATH -> ~/ibbrowsers/sysroot, FONTCONFIG_FILE -> ~/ibbrowsers/fonts.conf) then execs the real driver next to it. SELinux enforcing: no issue seen.
